name: Steal A Lucky Egg
desc:
🥚 Welcome to Steal A Luck Egg!

How to Play:
🥚 Steal eggs from biomes
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare Brainrots
💰 Earn money from your Brainrots
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and base
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
🥷 Steal eggs from other players
🔄 Rebirth for permanent multipliers
✨ Discover rarer eggs, sizes, and mutations!

👍 Like & join the group for codes!
🎮 Desktop, Console, Mobile & Tablet
